verses.en: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
verses.sm: Asafo, ma Hemana, ma lutana, e perofeta i kitara, ma napeli, ma sumepalo; o le faitau foi lenei o i latou o tagata fai galuega e tusa ma a latou galuega;

verses.en: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.
verses.sm: 0 atalii o Asafo, o Sakuro, ma Iosefa, ma Netania, ma Asarelu, o atalii o Asafo e pule ai Asafo, o le na perofeta ane e tusa ma le poloaiga a le tupu.

verses.en: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.
verses.sm: O Iutana; o atalii o Iutana, o Ketalaia, ma Seri, ma Isaia, o Hasapea, ma Matitia, e toaono, e pule ai lo latou tama o Iutana, o le na perofeta i kitara e faafetai ma vivii atu i le ALIT.

verses.en: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:
verses.sm: O Hemana; o atalii o Hemana, o Pukia, o Matania, o Usialu, o Sepuelu, ma leremota, o Hanania, o Hanani, o Eliata, o Kitaleti, ma Romametiesera, o Isepekasa, o Maloti, o Otira, o Maasiota;

verses.en: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.sm: o i latou uma ia o atalii o Hemana, o le tagata vaai a O le tofia o le au fai pese le tupu i mea a le Atua, e faamaualugaina le nifo. Ua foai mai foi e le Atua ia Hemana o atali e toasefulu ma le toafa, ma afafine e toatolu.

verses.en: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
verses.sm: O i latou uma ia na pule ai lo latou tama i pesega i le fale o le ALH i sumepalo, ma napeli, ma kitara, mo le galuega i le fale o le Atua, e pei o le poloaiga a le tupu ia Asafo, ma Iutana, ma Hemana.

verses.en: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.sm: O le faitau aofai o i latou, atoa ma o latou uso o e na a‘oa‘oina i pesega i le ALII, o i latou uma e na popoto, e lua selau ma le valu o sefulu ma le toavalu.

verses.en: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
verses.sm: Ua latou fai ai le vili i o latou tausiga, o e iti e tusa ma e matutua, o le aʻoaʻo ma le ua aʻoaʻoina.

verses.en: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:
verses.sm: Ua faasaga le vili muamua a Asafo ia Iosefa; o lona lua ia Ketalia, o ia, ma ona uso, ma ona atalii, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The third to Zaccur, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona tolu ia Sakuro, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The fourth to Izri, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona fa ia Iesaru, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The fifth to Nethaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona lima ia Netania, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The sixth to Bukkiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona ono ia Pukia, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The seventh to Jesharelah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona fitu ia Isaraelu, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: lona valu ia Isaia, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The ninth to Mattaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona iva ia Matania, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The tenth to Shimei, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona sefulu ia Semi, o ja, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toa621 I. NOFOAIGA lua;

verses.en: The eleventh to Azareel, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona sefulu ma le tasi ia Asareelu, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, E toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona sefulu ma le lua ia Hasapea, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The thirteenth to Shubael, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona sefulu ma le tolu ia Sopaelu, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: O lona sefulu ma le fa ia Matitia, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona sefulu ma le lima ia leremota, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona sefulu ma le ono ia Hanania, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona sefulu ma le fitu ia Isepekasa, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The eighteenth to Hanani, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona sefulu ma le valu ia Hanani, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona sefulu ma le iva ia Maloti, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The twentieth to Eliathah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona lua sefulu ia Eliata, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona lua sefulu ma le tasi ia Otira, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona lua sefulu ma le lua ia Kitaleti, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.sm: o lona lua sefulu ma le tolu ia Maasiota, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua;

verses.en: The four and twentieth to Romamti-ezer, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.
verses.sm: o lona lua sefulu ma le fa ia Romameti-esera, o ia, ma ona atalii, ma ona uso, e toasefulu ma le toalua.
